title: WhatsApp Lottery & Prize Winner Claim
summary: A colorful certificate arrives on WhatsApp stating your phone number won ₹25,00,000 in a television lottery. A representative asks for ₹12,500 advance tax clearance.

messages.body: CONGRATULATIONS! Your mobile SIM card has won ₹25,00,000 in the 2026 Special TV Mega Draw. To deposit this amount to your savings account today, transfer ₹12,500 government clearance tax to our nodal officer.
redFlags: You never purchased a lottery ticket or entered any contest
Demands upfront advance payment to release winnings
Uses prestigious TV show brand name without authorization

actions.label: Ask: 'If I won, why not deduct ₹12,500 from the prize?'
actions.commentary: You tested the core logic: legitimate lotteries deduct tax at source (TDS), they never ask winners to pay upfront.

actions.label: Transfer ₹12,500 advance fee to receive ₹25,00,000
actions.commentary: You transferred real advance money for an imaginary prize.

actions.label: Block and report sender on WhatsApp
actions.commentary: You instantly recognized the classic advance-fee lottery scam.

hints.nudge: Did you ever enter this lottery? Can you win a lottery you never bought a ticket for?
hints.explain: You cannot win a contest you never entered. In India, lottery taxes (TDS under Sec 194B) are legally deducted from the prize, never paid upfront by the winner.
hints.showMe: Tap 'Block and report sender on WhatsApp'.

messages.body: If I won ₹25 lakhs, please deduct ₹12,500 from the winnings and send me the rest.
Sir system rules do not allow deduction. If you do not transfer ₹12,500 within 30 minutes, your prize will be cancelled and given to next number!

actions.label: Block number immediately — artificial urgency confirms fraud
actions.commentary: The scammer's refusal and 30-minute threat proved it was an extortion attempt.

hints.nudge: The scammer gave an evasive answer and applied high pressure.
hints.explain: Real prizes never expire in 30 minutes.

saferChoices: Remember the golden rule: If you didn't buy a ticket, you didn't win a prize.
Legitimate entities never ask for 'clearance fees', 'GST charges', or 'processing taxes' to release winnings.
Do not interact with lottery forwards on WhatsApp; report them as spam.
recoverySteps: Report the transaction immediately to 1930 and file a complaint on cybercrime.gov.in.
Provide the recipient UPI ID and mobile phone number to your local cyber cell.
Block all related phone numbers and advise family members not to respond to similar messages.
